criteria.label: Transformation Promise
criteria.description: Clear, specific outcome clients can expect
riskIndicators: Outcome depends on factors outside your control
fixSuggestions: Narrow focus to one specific outcome

criteria.label: Credibility & Authority
criteria.description: Evidence that you can deliver the promised transformation
riskIndicators: No client testimonials or case studies
fixSuggestions: Coach 3-5 people for free to get testimonials
Get certified if credibility gap exists

criteria.label: Target Market Clarity
criteria.description: Specific audience that urgently needs your solution
fixSuggestions: Target people in active transition moments
Focus on B2B if B2C can't afford you
Identify where your audience gathers online

criteria.label: Pricing & Business Model
criteria.description: Sustainable pricing that reflects value delivered
fixSuggestions: Price based on value of transformation
Create a signature program with fixed price
Build in upsell to ongoing support

criteria.label: Client Acquisition
criteria.description: Repeatable system to attract qualified clients

failurePatterns.description: Generic life coach with no specific niche or transformation
Selling transformation without evidence you can deliver it
Targeting people who can't afford or don't urgently need coaching
Trading hours for dollars with no leverage or scale
